fiat.description: Supported fiat currencies, including USD, ordered by code.

code.description: Uppercase currency or stablecoin code, such as EUR or USDT.

fractionDigits.description: Default display fraction digits, including zero for currencies such as JPY. This is a formatting default, not rate precision, token decimals, or cash rounding. Stablecoins use two display fraction digits.

symbol.description: Representative local display symbol; multiple currencies may share a symbol. Uses the code when the selected local display data has no distinct visible symbol.

stablecoins.description: Supported stablecoins (USDC and USDT), ordered by code.

code.description: Uppercase currency or stablecoin code, such as EUR or USDT.

fractionDigits.description: Default display fraction digits, including zero for currencies such as JPY. This is a formatting default, not rate precision, token decimals, or cash rounding. Stablecoins use two display fraction digits.

symbol.description: Representative local display symbol; multiple currencies may share a symbol. Uses the code when the selected local display data has no distinct visible symbol.

fiat.description: Complete fiat snapshot; absent until a complete snapshot has been observed.

rates.description: Complete fiat rates, including USD, ordered by code.

unitsPerUsd.description: Fiat currency units per 1 USD as an exact decimal string.

sourceTsSec.description: Shared source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stale.description: True once the source observation is at least two hours old.

snapshotTsSec.description: Response construction time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stablecoins.description: Observed stablecoin rates ordered by code. Unobserved stablecoins are omitted.

sourceTsSec.description: This stablecoin's source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

stale.description: True once this stablecoin's source observation is at least five seconds old.

usdPerUnit.description: USD per 1 stablecoin unit as an exact decimal string.

bucket.description: Sampling interval between points; currently always "15m".

endTsSec.description: Last sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

pairs.description: Pairs ordered by ascending symbol_id; at most 2000, each included once.

symbolId.description: Stable pair ID. Pairs are ordered by ascending ID, each included exactly once.

volumeUsd.description: Trailing-24h USD volume as decimal strings. Exactly points values aligned with the shared grid, oldest first. Zero means no executed trades.

points.description: Number of aligned values in every pair array and the total array; always 97.

startTsSec.description: First sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

totalVolumeUsd.description: Total trailing-24h USD volume as decimal strings. Exactly points values, oldest first, aligned with every pair. Index i maps to startTsSec + i * 900 seconds. Zero means no trades; unavailable valuations fail the request.

markets.description: Market overview rows for the requested page.

bestAsk.description: Current best ask price as a decimal string in quote asset units.

bestAskQty.description: Best ask quantity as a decimal string in base asset units.

bestBid.description: Current best bid price as a decimal string in quote asset units.

bestBidQty.description: Best bid quantity as a decimal string in base asset units.

change24hBps.description: Rolling 24h change expressed in basis points (bp). Example: +123 = +1.23%. Measured from the 24h open to the last price, at minute granularity: the 24h open is the price at the start of the minute that contains the time 24h ago or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade. 0 while the 24h open is unavailable (open_24h_ticks is 0 then): the market has no trade yet (its last trade timestamp is 0 too), its first trade is a few seconds old, or its trade history is temporarily unavailable.

high24h.description: Highest price in the rolling 24h window, counting its open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

indexPrice.description: Current multi-venue index price as a decimal string in quote asset units. Zero when no fresh, valid index price is available.

lastPrice.description: Last traded price as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '28334.99'.

lastTradeTsNs.description: Last trade timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

listedTsNs.description: Listing timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch. 0 when the pair has no listing time.

low24h.description: Lowest price in the rolling 24h window, counting its open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

open24h.description: The rolling 24h open that change24hBps is measured from, as a decimal string in quote asset units. Zero while the open is unavailable, including when history is temporarily unavailable: the market has no trade yet, its first trade is a few seconds old, or its trade history cannot be read for a while.

openUtcDay.description: Price at the start of the current UTC day (00:00 UTC), as a decimal string in quote asset units. Zero while the open is unavailable, including when history is temporarily unavailable: the market has no trade yet, a new day's first price is still being recorded (a few seconds after 00:00 UTC), or its trade history cannot be read for a while.

priceBand.description: The pair's live price band, as GetPriceBand returns it, present only while a band was confirmed current within the last 5 seconds. Absent means no fresh band is known, not that the pair has no band. This is a convenience copy: the market overview stream sends a row again when its band changes, appears or lapses, not on each confirmation, so a copy whose valid_until_ts_ns has passed is unknown. Check order prices against GetPriceBand or the price band stream.

asOf.description: When the band was last confirmed current.

epoch.description: The band's epoch, an unsigned 64-bit decimal string. It never decreases, and a band of a greater epoch is newer. Compare updateId only within one epoch.

maxBuyPrice.description: The highest buy limit price admitted, inclusive, as a decimal string. Present only when state is ACTIVE.

maxSellPrice.description: The highest sell limit price admitted, inclusive, as a decimal string. Present only when state is ACTIVE and the band limits passive prices too.

minBuyPrice.description: The lowest buy limit price admitted, inclusive, as a decimal string. Present only when state is ACTIVE and the band limits passive prices too.

minSellPrice.description: The lowest sell limit price admitted, inclusive, as a decimal string. Present only when state is ACTIVE.

parameters.description: The band's settings, as GetSpotConfig returns them. Absent when the state is OFF, or when the settings in effect cannot be expressed exactly in basis points and milliseconds; the limits above are authoritative either way.

lowerBps.description: How far below the reference price a sell may be priced or trade, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). The lower limit is the reference price times (1 - lower_bps / 10000), rounded up to the tick size.

referenceWindowMs.description: How long the reference price stays fixed before it can move to a newer trade, in milliseconds. Zero moves it with every order.

upperBps.description: How far above the reference price a buy may be priced or trade, in basis points. The upper limit is the reference price times (1 + upper_bps / 10000), rounded down to the tick size.

reanchorEligibleAt.description: From when the next order operation on the pair may move the reference price. Nothing moves at that time by itself. Present when state is ACTIVE or EMPTY.

reanchorPending.description: True when a trade newer than the reference price is waiting: once the re-anchor eligibility time has passed, the next order operation moves the reference to it, unless the index price moves it instead. False does not promise that the band stays: a move to the index price needs no trade.

referencePrice.description: The band's reference price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'. Present when state is ACTIVE or EMPTY.

referenceSource.description: Where the reference price came from. REFERENCE_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED when the state is OFF or UNKNOWN.

symbol.description: The pair's symbol, for example BTC-USDT.

updateId.description: Increases with each band update within an epoch, and may increase without one, as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string. Compare it only within one epoch: a greater value is newer.

updatedAt.description: When the band last changed: its first setting, OFF included, a change of its settings, or a move of its reference price, to the same price included.

validUntil.description: asOf plus 5 seconds. After it, treat the band as unknown and read it again.

close.description: Newest-first close prices as decimal strings in quote asset units.

interval.description: Time range and sampling resolution represented by these close prices.

stats1h.description: Rolling 1h stats, over the same minute-granular window as the 24h stats. Absent while the window's open is unavailable, including when history is temporarily unavailable: the market has no trade yet, its first trade is a few seconds old, or the window's trade history cannot be read for a while. Later fields may add volumes per window.

changeBps.description: Change from the open to the last price in basis points (bp), truncated toward zero. Example: +123 = +1.23%.

high.description: Highest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

low.description: Lowest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

open.description: Price at the start of the window as a decimal string in quote asset units: the last trade price before the window's first minute or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade.

stats4h.description: Rolling 4h stats. Absent under the same conditions as stats_1h.

changeBps.description: Change from the open to the last price in basis points (bp), truncated toward zero. Example: +123 = +1.23%.

high.description: Highest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

low.description: Lowest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

open.description: Price at the start of the window as a decimal string in quote asset units: the last trade price before the window's first minute or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade.

stats7d.description: Rolling 7-day stats. Absent under the same conditions as stats_1h.

changeBps.description: Change from the open to the last price in basis points (bp), truncated toward zero. Example: +123 = +1.23%.

high.description: Highest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

low.description: Lowest price in the window, counting the open and every trade, as a decimal string in quote asset units.

open.description: Price at the start of the window as a decimal string in quote asset units: the last trade price before the window's first minute or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade.

tradeCount24h.description: Number of trades executed in the rolling 24h window, as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

volume24hBase.description: Rolling 24h base volume as a decimal string in base asset units. Omitted when the volume exceeds the supported range.

volume24hQuote.description: Rolling 24h executed quote volume as a decimal string in quote asset units. Omitted when the volume exceeds the supported range.

volume24hUsd.description: Rolling 24h USD volume as a decimal string in USD with up to 6 decimal places. Applies the current quote/USD conversion to the rolling quote volume. When conversion is unavailable, USDT and USDC are valued at USD parity. Omitted for other quote assets when a current conversion is unavailable.

vwap24h.description: Rolling 24h volume-weighted average trade price as a decimal string in quote asset units, rounded down: the exact quote notional divided by the 24h base volume. The notional is not rounded to the quote scale, so dividing volume24hQuote by volume24hBase can differ slightly. The base volume is exact when the base asset's marketDataVolumeScale equals its quantityScale; otherwise each second with trades rounds its base volume by at most half a volume unit. Omitted when the window has no base volume or volume24hBase is omitted.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE: The pair's index price, on the tick grid: the reference moves there when the candidate reference lies outside the band around the index price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_TRADE: The price of the pair's last trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LISTING_REFERENCE: The pair's listing reference price, on a pair that has not traded yet.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The band is on and at least one price lies inside it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY: The band is on and no price lies inside it: every order that adds exposure, market orders included, is rejected with PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION until the reference price or the band's settings change. This is not a trading halt.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OFF: The pair applies no price band.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN: No band was confirmed current within the last 5 seconds: do not rely on the band received before. Only the price band streams send it, once, when the band lapses; GetPriceBand answers PRICE_BAND_STALE or PRICE_BAND_UNKNOWN instead, which means the same. An UNKNOWN band has no prices, reference source or settings. Its epoch, update ID and as-of time are those of the last confirmation of the band it replaces, 0 when there was none, and its update and valid-until times equal its as-of time. Keep the band with the greatest epoch, then update ID, then as-of time; at an equal one, UNKNOWN replaces the band, and a later confirmation replaces UNKNOWN.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DATE_ADDED: Sort by listing time (new listings first).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_PRICE: Sort by last price in quote units scaled by 1e9.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VOLUME_24H_USD: Sort by canonical USD 24h volume. Unvalued markets sort last in either direction.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.1h: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1mo: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1w: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.24h: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

Public trading API for market makers and integrators.

get.description: Get supported fiat and stablecoin display metadata with default English names, symbols, and fraction digits. Clients may localize presentation.
get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Get fiat units per USD and USD per stablecoin unit, grouped with source freshness.
get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: List ticker-style market overview rows with optional sparklines. Supports symbol filtering, last price, 24h change and 24h USD volume range filters, sorting, and pagination controls.

parameters.description: When true, include sparklines in each market.
parameters.name: includeSparklines

parameters.description: Maximum markets to return (server default 50, max 2000).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only markets whose signed change24hBps is at most this, inclusive; 1000 is +10%. Not below minChange24hBps. Omit for no upper bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: maxChange24hBps

parameters.description: Only markets whose lastPrice is at most this, inclusive, as a decimal string in quote asset units with at most 9 decimal places; not below minLastPrice. Omit for no upper bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: maxLastPrice

parameters.description: Only markets whose volume24hUsd is at most this, inclusive, as a decimal string in USD with at most 6 decimal places; not below minVolume24hUsd. Omit for no upper bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: maxVolume24hUsd

parameters.description: Only markets whose signed change24hBps is at least this, inclusive; -500 is -5%. A market whose 24h change has no open (open24h is zero) never matches a change bound. Sorting by CHANGE_24H_BPS still uses the absolute change. Omit for no lower bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: minChange24hBps

parameters.description: Only markets whose lastPrice is at least this, inclusive, as a decimal string in quote asset units with at most 9 decimal places. A market with no trade yet never matches a price bound. Omit for no lower bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: minLastPrice

parameters.description: Only markets whose volume24hUsd is at least this, inclusive, as a decimal string in USD with at most 6 decimal places. A market whose volume24hUsd is omitted never matches a volume bound. Omit for no lower bound; an empty, malformed or repeated value is refused with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: minVolume24hUsd

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response, bound to the symbol and range filters, the sort key and the sort direction: reuse it with the same filters. A cursor reused with other filters or another sort is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT; request the first page again. Each page is cut from current values, so a market whose sort value or range membership changes between pages can appear twice or not at all across them. For a consistent list, request a single page with the maximum limit.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Filter by stable pair IDs; repeat this parameter for multiple pairs. Combines with symbols; a pair named more than once, through either parameter, counts once. Selects every configured market, disabled ones included; an unknown pair ID is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT, and an ID that is not a positive integer with BAD_REQUEST.
parameters.name: symbolId

parameters.description: Filter by specific symbols; repeat query param (e.g., ?symbols=BTC-USDT&symbols=ETH-USDT). Selects every configured market, disabled ones included; an unknown symbol is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT. A repeated symbol counts once.
parameters.name: symbols

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Get aligned columnar pair-level and total trailing-24h USD volume at 15-minute intervals over the latest day. Exactly 97 values per array and at most 2000 pairs. Unavailable valuations fail the request.

parameters.description: Stable pair IDs; repeat this parameter for multiple pairs. Empty selects all currently listed pairs. At most 2000 distinct positive IDs; unknown IDs are rejected.
parameters.name: symbolId
